# ChartPulse

> Among millions of stars, ChartPulse gives you the brightest.

ChartPulse is a multi-market trading research tool that scans stocks, indices, futures, forex and crypto instruments. It provides rule-based signal scanning, market bias analysis, and backtesting tools. ChartPulse is an analytics and education tool, not investment advice.

## Key Pages

- [Overview](https://chartpulse.io/) — Live global market dashboard with movers, bias and heatmap
- [Tier-1 Scanner](https://chartpulse.io/scanner.html) — Rule-based signal scanner for live markets
- [Bias Check](https://chartpulse.io/bias/) — Daily directional bias for all tracked instruments
- [Market Movers](https://chartpulse.io/movers/) — Biggest daily movers across all markets
- [Backtesting](https://chartpulse.io/pro-backtesting) — Test trading ideas against historical data
- [Bottom Reversal Scanner](https://chartpulse.io/dashboard.html) — Daily bottom zone reversal detection
- [Market Insights](https://chartpulse.io/insights.html) — AI-generated market analysis
- [News & Impact](https://chartpulse.io/news.html) — Market news with impact scoring
- [Pricing](https://chartpulse.io/pricing.html) — Plans: Starter, Core, Algo
